result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial with a marked crosswalk that lacks signalization or a refuge island. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian-scale lighting or traffic calming measures create a high-exposure environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge or signalized protection.

hazards.name: Lack of Signalization
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk is uncontrolled, requiring pedestrians to find gaps in traffic on a wide road.
hazards.location_in_image: Crosswalk area in the center of the image

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a protected interval for pedestrians to cross the wide arterial.
